source.title: Swiss Federal Office of Public Health · Heat

tips.title: Check the weather
tips.text: Check MeteoSwiss or Alertswiss heat warnings before leaving.

tips.title: Bring water
tips.text: Drink water regularly during hot weather.

tips.title: Find some shade
tips.text: Plan to spend time in shade or cool places.

tips.title: Choose a cooler time
tips.text: Avoid strenuous walking during the hottest hours.
